title: Signal: SHA-1 use via Insecure.SHA1.hash (swift) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the Insecure.SHA1.hash call in swift code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches any Insecure.SHA1.hash call regardless of purpose. Name-selected SHA-1 and other weak algorithms are separate rules.
fpNotes: Git object ids, legacy protocol interop, and checksums are the common false positives.
